name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-S12 Sport 'Skeetmaster'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-S12 Sport is a semi-automatic shotgun chambered in 12 gauge with a 28-inch barrel, adjustable comb stock, and a gas system tuned for light competition loads. The weapon is a purpose-built sporting shotgun for trap, skeet, and sporting clays — competitive shooting disciplines that continue to thrive in GLMZ's Mid-tier recreational facilities.

The Skeetmaster is not a combat weapon and makes no pretense of being one. The 28-inch barrel is too long for tactical use, the light-load gas tuning won't reliably cycle heavy buckshot, and the adjustable stock is designed for consistent mount position rather than rapid deployment. But for breaking clay targets at forty meters, the VS-S12 Sport is among the finest tools available. The long barrel provides a smooth swing, the gas system absorbs recoil to enable fast follow-up shots on doubles, and the adjustable stock allows the shooter to fine-tune the fit.

Volkov-Saito's involvement in the sporting shotgun market reflects the company's belief that precision matters in every context. The Skeetmaster applies the same engineering philosophy to clay targets that their tactical products apply to threats. In competitive shooting, the VS-S12 Sport has accumulated enough podium finishes to validate the approach.
specifications:
caliber: 12 gauge
effective_range: 45 meters (sporting loads)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 4+1 rounds
weight: 3.2 kg
tactical_use: No tactical application. This is a dedicated sporting shotgun designed for clay target competitions. The long barrel, light-load gas system, and adjustable stock optimize for consistent pattern delivery at sporting distances. Not suitable for defensive or offensive use. Could theoretically be pressed into service as a slug gun at extended range, but any tactical operator with other options would choose them.
cultural_context: The Skeetmaster represents the civilian sporting tradition in GLMZ — a reminder that not all firearms are weapons and not all shooting is violence. Competitive shooting clubs in the Mids serve as social institutions where people from different backgrounds meet on equal terms with identical equipment. The VS-S12 Sport is the centerpiece of that culture.
story_hooks: A championship clay shooter is recruited for an assassination specifically because their sporting skill with a shotgun translates to lethal capability at a range the target's security doesn't account for.
A Mid-tier shooting club is used as a front for weapons trafficking. The Skeetmasters on the racks are legitimate; what's in the basement is not.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purposeful sporting shotgun with an elegant profile emphasizing length and balance. The 28-inch barrel dominates the silhouette, creating a smooth, swept appearance optimized for swing. The stock is noticeably adjustable with visible comb hardware. Overall impression: refined competitor's tool, not a combat weapon.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 127 cm | Barrel: 71 cm | Height at comb: 12 cm | Receiver width: 5.5 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable—3.2 kg distributed forward to the barrel for smooth tracking. Feels lighter than it is due to mass concentration, enabling fast target acquisition on doubles.
physical_description.primary_material: Aluminum alloy receiver with steel barrel and gas tube. Foregrip and stock utilize aerospace-grade polymer reinforced with carbon fiber weave for vibration damping.
physical_description.finish: Matte black anodized aluminum receiver with satin-chrome gas system components. Barrel features a non-reflective deep-bore finish to reduce glint. Stock has a subtle brushed charcoal texture.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: matte black receiver and barrel | Accents: satin chrome gas system, silver adjustment knobs on comb, gunmetal gray foregrip
physical_description.grip_texture: Foregrip wrapped in thin, tacky polymer with fine radial ridging for secure mounting during swing. Stock features a rubberized adjustable comb pad and textured Monte Carlo cheekrest.
distinctive_features: Adjustable comb mechanism with numbered detent settings visible on left side
Oversized ejection port with polished chrome surround
Red anodized gas system pressure relief valve stem
Volkov-Saito competition rib with sight bead and mid-rib reference line
Custom engraved receiver panel: 'VS-S12 SPORT SKEETMASTER' in serif font
Fine spiral porting along final 8 cm of barrel (2×3 pattern)
Shell carrier on side of receiver showing patent date
Safety lever with detent click feedback, positioned for index finger
Glossy black VOLKOV-SAITO medallion inlaid in right side of stock
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Large 'VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION' stamp on top of receiver near comb | 'VS-S12 SPORT' engraved in script below ejection port | Serial number on left-side barrel flat | Patent references micro-stamped on gas tube | Small Cyrillic character Φ (currency mark homage) inlaid near magazine tube
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained, often with light scuff marks from competition carry cases. Barrel shows minor handling marks. Stock may display tape residue from custom comb adjustments. Gas system kept clean and lubricated. Receiver free of corrosion but showing character from regular range use.
